payload.body:
## Context
A local auth service now handles GitHub browser OAuth callbacks via `auth.hack.gy` and localhost fallback. We need to keep this as a stable integration entrypoint for additional providers.

## Goals
- Define provider callback contract for auth server routes
- Add provider registration surface (`/v1/auth/providers` already present) with typed status payloads
- Document callback security model and host/routing requirements

## Notes
- Keep daemon-owned auth service lightweight
- Prefer keychain/secret-ref storage for provider secrets and tokens

## Links
- src/daemon/routes/auth.ts
- src/daemon/server.ts
- src/templates.ts
- docs/extensions.md
payload.title: Generalize local auth server for provider callbacks

payload.body:
## Context
The macOS GitHub extension now uses browser-first OAuth via local auth server callbacks, but users still need to configure OAuth client id + client secret storage out-of-band.

## Goals
- Add in-app GitHub OAuth app credential configuration (client id + keychain secret write)
- Validate credentials before starting browser flow
- Show actionable setup guidance when config is missing

## Notes
- Keep secret storage keychain-backed (no plain-text config values)
- Keep multi-profile account list UX unchanged

## Links
- apps/macos/Packages/Features/DashboardFeature/Sources/DashboardFeature/SettingsOverlayView.swift
- src/daemon/routes/auth.ts
payload.title: GitHub OAuth app credential setup UX in macOS app
